name: Fire Storm
summary: Fills up to ten 10-foot Cubes with roaring flames that deal Fire damage.

stats.effect:
A storm of fire appears within range. The area of the storm consists of up to ten 10-foot Cubes, which you arrange as you like. Each {ref:glossary/cube} must be contiguous with at least one other Cube. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.
